channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula tem 48% e Flávio soma 39,1% no 2º turno, mostra CNT/MDA
item.description: A CNT/MDA poll released on Tuesday shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading the potential runoff with 48% of voting intentions, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) trails at 39,1%. Lula holds an 8.9-point advantage, indicating a stable lead in the presidential race.

item.title: CNT/MDA: Lula lidera corrida presidencial contra Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, por 48% a 39%
item.description: According to the CNT/MDA poll released on March 11, 2025, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race in a potential second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, with 48% of voting intentions compared to Bolsonaro’s 39.1%. Lula holds an 8.9-point advantage, underscoring his strong position against a candidate aligned with the Bolsonaro political family.

item.title: Após vídeo de Bolsonaro, Flávio diz ao TSE que uso de IA em campanha não exige autorização prévia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's defense told the TSE that the use of artificial intelligence in political campaigns cannot be banned or require prior authorization, arguing that tools like deepfakes are legitimate extensions of political communication and that regulation should focus on intent to deceive, not the technology itself. The submission came ahead of a TSE meeting to discuss ruling on a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro aired at the convention that formalized Flávio as the PL's presidential candidate.

item.title: Após crise, Flávio confirma gravação com Michelle para programa eleitoral e elogia ex-primeira-dama: ‘Pessoa qualificada’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed that Michelle Bolsonaro will participate in the filming of his electoral program, marking their first in-person meeting since the rift during the presidential ticket formation. He praised her as a 'qualified person', specifically highlighting her work with the deaf community during Jair Bolsonaro’s administration. The collaboration aims to bolster Flávio’s presidential campaign and Michelle’s Senate bid in the DF, with allies also seeking to leverage her electoral capital in their own campaigns.

item.title: Os ataques ‘sem precedentes’ ao Brasil, segundo Mauro Vieira
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira described the attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei and U.S. President Donald Trump on Brazil as 'unprecedented,' citing Milei's insults toward President Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, as well as U.S. tariffs. He characterized these behaviors as gross, affronts to Brazilian sovereignty and democracy, and said they must be repelled, referencing the 'Hour of the Predators' concept from Giuliano da Empoli's book.

item.title: Renan Santos: por que parte da Faria Lima embarcou no discurso radical do candidato estreante em eleições
item.description: A segment of São Paulo’s financial elite, Faria Lima, has embraced the radical discourse of presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão), viewing him as a disruptive alternative to the political establishment. This support emerged despite Eduardo Bolsonaro’s cassation and his June live-stream questioning of Santos’ electoral potential. The backing reflects a desire for systemic change among economically influential groups dissatisfied with current polarization.

item.title: TSE deve acelerar definição sobre IA e pesquisas para evitar contaminar campanhas
item.description: The TSE aims to establish rules in the coming weeks regarding the use of AI-generated avatars and permissible tools in electoral polls, to prevent these issues from influencing the 2026 campaigns. The discussion includes regulating or banning deepfakes, such as the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro used at the PL convention, and potentially allowing videos and audio in research questionnaires if registered with the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aposta em ‘tesouraço’ e âncora fiscal baseada em dívida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has centered his 2026 election campaign on tax cuts, deregulation, legal security, and private investment incentives, without presenting a structured government plan. Fiscally, he proposes replacing the current LRF rule with a debt-to-GDP-based framework featuring automatic spending cuts triggered when a yet-undefined threshold is exceeded. His economic coordinator, Daniella Marques, advocates a PEC to make this rule more restrictive, but questions remain about how to reconcile tax cuts with debt reduction and the intended flexibility of the Fiscal Responsibility Law.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Fachin quer moralizar o STF e a briga de aloprados nas eleições
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discusses accusations against federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) linked to vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), and the new effort by STF President Minister Luís Roberto Barroso to moralize the Judiciary, highlighting political and judicial tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘PSOL não é bem-vindo’, diz Kalil sobre adesão de federação de esquerda à sua campanha em Minas
item.description: Alexandre Kalil (PDT), Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, rejected PSOL’s inclusion in his ticket, stating only Rede Sustentabilidade is welcome, despite the PSOL-Rede federation voting to support him internally. The move creates tension with the national PSOL leadership, which seeks to overturn the decision and realign with the PT, while Kalil views the federation as a threat to his political independence. The development also affects the Senate race, where PSOL’s Áurea Carolina faces PT’s Marília Campos, as the PT prioritizes a centrist PSB candidate for the second Senate seat.

item.title: Com bullying de 5ª série, Milei vira cabo eleitoral de Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei faced backlash for making offensive remarks about Brazil and its president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, triggering a negative reaction among the Brazilian public. Despite his attempt to position himself as an ideological ally of Lula, his conduct was perceived as arrogant and disrespectful, indirectly strengthening Lula’s image as a defender of national sovereignty. The episode shows how external criticism, even from ideologically aligned figures, can be rejected when perceived as overbearing.

item.title: Metade dos brasileiros defende proibição de propaganda eleitoral feita com IA, aponta CNT/MDA
item.description: Half of Brazilians support banning AI-generated political videos and ads in the 2026 elections, according to a CNT/MDA poll released on Tuesday, the 11th. The findings reflect growing concerns about disinformation and electoral manipulation through advanced technologies.

item.title: Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro gravam propaganda eleitoral nesta terça
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL-DF) are recording the first electoral advertisement video for the 2026 elections this Tuesday (11/8). This marks their first in-person meeting since a campaign crisis, when Michelle claimed she was disrespected by her stepson. Flávio also has a busy schedule meeting with Senate candidates, while Michelle is not expected to attend those gatherings.

item.title: 'Se pensar fosse crime, a maioria das pessoas teria de ser detida', diz Zema sobre condenados por atos golpistas de 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo party, criticized the convictions of those involved in the January 8th riots, arguing that thinking about or planning a crime should not be equated with committing it. He described the events as 'hooliganism' and vandalism, denying they constituted an attempted coup, and maintained that only executed actions should be severely punished.

item.title: TSE decide nesta quinta data de julgamento sobre IA de Bolsonaro e deepfake eleitoral
item.description: The TSE scheduled a Thursday meeting to set the date for a collegial ruling on an AI-generated deepfake video of former President Jair Bolsonaro expressing support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision aims to establish a precedent for the 2026 elections by applying the TSE resolution banning synthetic content that favors or harms candidates. Ministers are divided on interpreting the rule in the context of AI use in political communication.

item.title: Resposta dos Estados Unidos à OMC é vitória brasileira
item.description: Brazil secured a diplomatic victory by getting the United States to agree to WTO consultations on U.S. trade surcharges, despite the institution being weakened. China also announced it would join the discussion alongside Brazil, reinforcing multilateral support. While experts view the move as procedural, the U.S. acceptance marks a rare moment of dialogue amid the Trump administration’s broader rejection of international norms.

item.title: JOTA Principal: TSE busca enfrentar controvérsias com potencial para afetar disputa presidencial
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is seeking to establish rules for two emerging controversies in the 2026 presidential campaign: the use of AI avatars (such as Jair Bolsonaro’s at the PL convention) and limits on audio/video use in electoral research questionnaires. The TSE aims to prevent these issues from lingering and affecting the race, considering bans, fines, or mandatory registration in the Electoral Justice system, based on a PT lawsuit and the AtlasIntel poll controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Crusoé: Haddad culpa Congresso e varejistas por taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, blamed the National Congress and national retailers for implementing the 'blusinhas tax,' a levy on international purchases under $50 that was later repealed by the federal government due to public backlash. He stated the tax was a political mistake and should not have been introduced.

item.title: Nova pesquisa em SP testa Tarcísio x Haddad após primeiro debate na Band
item.description: A new Vox Brasil Institute poll in São Paulo will measure the contest between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad following the first Band debate, surveying 1,480 voters starting Tuesday, August 11, with results set for release on Sunday, August 16. The survey will assess voting intention, rejection, approval of Tarcísio’s administration, and voter perceptions of the debate, including reach, evaluation, and topics discussed by the candidates.

item.title: Escândalo envolvendo o ex-assessor Marcola produz estragos para Lula nas redes
item.description: Lula's former chief of staff, Marcola, received R$ 249,000 from a lobbyist linked to the president's son and under investigation for alleged involvement in INSS mafia schemes, leading to his resignation and triggering 18.7 million social media interactions, 71% of which were critical or negative. The scandal evolved into a sustained digital narrative tying Lula, PT, Lulinha, INSS corruption, and the 2026 election, where the discourse detached from the original fact and gained autonomous momentum online.

item.title: Lindbergh classifica como fake news acusação de armação contra Gaspar
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) labeled as fake news the accusation that he paid a merchant to fabricate a rape complaint against Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro. He claimed the lie was based on the testimony of a figure who has persecuted him for years and is tied to the same political camp now trying to use the story as evidence. Lindbergh said he will continue to confront the far right with facts, proof, and truth.

item.title: Milei compartilha mensagem de deputado americano que chama Lula de ‘porco’
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared a post on Sunday, the 9th, from U.S. Representative Carlos Giménez, who called Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'pig' and 'criminal', linking him to a alleged Castro-communist dictatorship. Milei also reposted historical images of Lula being processed by the DOPS and an AI-generated video associating Lula with Nicolás Maduro. These actions occur amid a diplomatic crisis between Argentina and Brazil, with Milei repeatedly attacking Lula personally, accusing him of corruption and questioning the annulment of his convictions in the Lava Jato case.

item.title: Michelle gravará com Flávio nesta terça em primeiro encontro desde crise, dizem aliados
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro will meet in Brasília on Tuesday to record electoral materials, marking their first in-person encounter since the rift during the pre-presidential campaign. The recording, slated for use in free electoral TV time starting the 28th, symbolizes reconciliation after their disagreement over the PL’s internal Senate candidate selection in Ceará. Michelle will not attend Flávio’s morning meeting with approximately 50 Senate candidates, choosing instead to meet him afterward to avoid public exposure in a large setting.

item.title: Victor Fasano comenta sua postura antipetista e nega carreira política
item.description: Victor Fasano, the actor who left Globo in 2016 to focus on environmentalism, reiterated his anti-PT stance, stating he has never voted for Lula and never will, while supporting Bolsonaro. Despite his environmental work through the Airom Ambiental initiative, he denied any intention of entering politics, even to advocate for the environment.

item.title: Garotinho está inelegível? Entenda a decisão de suspensão direitos políticos e o que alega a defesa
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's judiciary suspended Anthony Garotinho's political rights after confirming the final judgment of his administrative improbity conviction linked to the 'Saúde em Movimento' program (2005-2006). Judge Ricardo Cyfer ordered notification to the TSE and TRE, rejecting the defense's claims that the judgment was not final and that no cause of ineligibility existed. Garotinho, a 2026 gubernatorial candidate for the Republicans party, is now ineligible under the Clean Record Law (Ficha Limpa).

item.title: Decreto regulamenta subvenção a produtores independentes de cana-de-açúcar do NE
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva issued a decree regulating the granting of economic subsidies to independent sugarcane producers in the Northeast who suffered losses. The measure aims to support these producers affected by adverse conditions, ensuring access to financial resources to mitigate losses.

item.title: Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem primeira gravação para o horário eleitoral nesta terça-feira
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro will record their first joint appearance for electoral airtime this Tuesday (11) in Brasília, marking their first in-person meeting following prior disagreements. The recording is not expected to include Michelle’s participation in other Flávio Bolsonaro events, such as the Senate candidates meeting or his initial campaign act in Rio.

item.title: Ata do Copom volta a citar política fiscal como fator de risco
item.description: The Copom again cited the Lula administration's fiscal policy as an inflation risk factor, emphasizing the need for harmonious and predictable fiscal and monetary policies. The committee warned that public spending and liquidity injections could affect debt sustainability and risk premiums, while maintaining caution due to elevated external uncertainties, particularly the Middle East crisis and U.S. economic policy. The minutes gave no forward guidance on interest rates, stating that the calibration cycle will be adjusted based on evolving conditions.

item.title: Está aberta a temporada de torcida política - ou é debate?
item.description: The 2026 electoral debate season kicked off with mixed results: the Tarcísio de Freitas vs. Fernando Haddad debate on Band was marked by low engagement due to its bureaucratic tone and excessive focus on numbers, serving more as a rehearsal for a potential 2030 presidential race. In contrast, the Federal District debate hosted by a local broadcaster featured sharp exchanges, with Ricardo Cappelli aggressively pressing Governor Celina Leão on the BRB financial crisis and the controversial attempt to acquire Banco Master’s loan portfolios, prompting her allies to privately consider skipping future debates as a tactic to avoid exposure when leading in polls.

item.title: Realtime indica empate técnico nos dois turnos na Bahia
item.description: The Realtime Big Data poll released on Tuesday shows a technical tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in both rounds of the 2026 Bahia gubernatorial race, though Neto leads numerically in all tested scenarios. In the first-round simulation, the former mayor of Salvador has 44% of voting intentions.

item.title: Cinegrafista que agrediu fotógrafo se pronuncia após demissão da Globo
item.description: Globo-demoted cameraman Gustavo Clemente expressed regret after assaulting photographer Igor Carvalho during a São Paulo gubernatorial debate Band coverage, claiming he faced prior provocations and verbal aggression. He did not justify his actions but sought to contextualize the incident amid rising tension. Globo condemned the violence and terminated his temporary contract, while Brasil de Fato and Band also denounced the attack and affirmed support for press freedom.

item.title: Os planos da Frente do Ambiente de Negócios para o período eleitoral
item.description: The Parliamentary Front for the Business Environment, in partnership with the Unidos Brasil Institute and the National Confederation of Commerce, is launching the Pact for Order and Progress, focusing on public safety, unfair competition, and other issues such as high interest rates, unequal competition with Asian products, and uncertainties about the tax reform. Meetings with presidential candidates Renan Santos (Missão) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) are also planned.

item.title: Oswaldo Malatesta assume gabinete pessoal de Lula no lugar de Marcola
item.description: Oswaldo Malatesta Neto has assumed the role of chief of staff in the personal office of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, replacing Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, who was dismissed following revelations of a loan from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, under investigation for influence peddling. Marcola confirmed the funds were a private loan, already repaid, and made his banking and tax records available to authorities. Malatesta, formerly deputy chief of staff for agenda and with prior experience at the Lula Institute, takes over the management of the president’s schedule and audiences at a strategic moment ahead of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Lula deve se reunir com empresários na abertura oficial de sua campanha
item.description: Lula's campaign plans an official opening with a meeting between the former president and business leaders, aiming to balance political messaging with support from the productive sector. The event takes place on Sunday, marking the start of the 2026 electoral season. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Presidente do TSE reúne ministros nesta quinta para tratar de IA e deve discutir ação contra Flávio
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques will meet with ministers this Thursday to discuss the use of artificial intelligence in electoral campaigns, focusing on the deepfake of Jair Bolsonaro used at the convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate. The PT has filed an action requesting judgment on the video, arguing it constitutes illegal early electoral propaganda despite the disclosure that it is a simulation. Flávio Bolsonaro’s defense denies wrongdoing, stating the AI use was transparent and did not amount to an explicit vote solicitation.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: The Minister of Institutional Relations, José Guimarães, accused Flávio Bolsonaro of being a traitor to the homeland for allegedly conspiring against Brazil in favor of U.S. interests, rather than defending policies such as Pix, the national economy, jobs, and workers.

item.title: Real Time Big Data: ACM e Jerônimo têm empate técnico no 1º e 2º turno na BA
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on August 11, 2026 shows a technical tie between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) in both rounds of the Bahia gubernatorial election. In the first round, ACM Neto leads with 44% to Jerônimo's 42%; in the runoff, 45% to 44%, within the two-point margin of error. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters from August 6–10, 2026, with a 95% confidence level and TSE registration BA-00277/2026.

item.title: Aliados de Haddad esperam debates mais quentes com Tarcísio
item.description: Allies of Fernando Haddad viewed his performance in the first debate against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas positively, noting that the Republican candidate appeared nervous during the exchange. They anticipate future debates to be more heated and intense, with stronger ideological confrontations.

item.title: Fluminense x Rivadavia: saiba onde assistir às oitavas da Libertadores
item.description: Fluminense and Independiente Rivadavia face off on Tuesday, August 11th at 7:00 PM Brasília time at Maracanã, in the first leg of the 2026 Copa Libertadores round of 16. Fluminense aims to overcome a domestic crisis following the World Cup, while Rivadavia enters as group C leaders, having won and drawn against the Tricolor in the group stage. The match will be broadcast live on ESPN (subscription TV) and Disney+ (streaming).

item.title: Hugo Motta declara ter R$ 250 mil em dinheiro vivo e apartamento subfaturado em Brasília
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies (Republicanos-PB), declared to electoral justice that he holds R$250,000 in cash outside bank accounts or financial investments, representing 19.8% of his total declared wealth of R$1.26 million. The disclosure has raised concerns about the source of funds and financial transparency, as the amount is kept outside the formal banking system. This is not the first time Motta has faced scrutiny over his asset declarations.

item.title: A repercussão nas redes do primeiro debate entre Tarcísio e Haddad
item.description: The first debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad for the São Paulo gubernatorial race generated over 6 million social media interactions in 24 hours, with 'Haddad' and 'Tarcísio' ranking among the top five trending topics on X. The term 'debate band' reached 12th place on Google Trends, peaking at 7:56 p.m. on Sunday, indicating strong public engagement.

item.title: O debate entre candidatos muda votos?
item.description: A survey of 664 readers found that 36.3% believe candidate debates change votes, 33.3% say they do not, and 30.4% think it only happens in exceptional cases. The content also includes pieces about Flávio’s fear of becoming a target of the right in Lula’s absence from the studio, as well as articles on anti-antifa movements and political satire.

item.title: Temendo “queimar a largada”, Planalto vai manter Berger no cargo
item.description: The Planalto has decided to keep Swedenberger Barbosa (Berger) in office despite speculation about his involvement with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, to avoid premature action before concrete evidence emerges. Investigators are probing whether Berger facilitated the release of Health Ministry funds to the Maranhão government, similar to the case of former chief of staff Marcola, who received R$249,000 from Luchsinger and was removed from Lula's campaign.

item.title: Sem encontrar Flávio desde crise, Michelle não deve ir a reunião com candidatos ao Senado nem a ato em Copacabana
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is unlikely to attend a meeting with Flávio Bolsonaro and Senate candidates on Tuesday, as she remains in Brasília to care for Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. Her absence delays their first in-person meeting since the presidential campaign crisis, despite their public reconciliation. Flávio’s campaign is trying to persuade her to join the Copacabana event on Sunday, but Michelle resists due to the challenge of leaving her caregiving routine.

item.title: Planalto descarta 'medida de força' dos EUA contra Lula, mas prevê pressão
item.description: The Brazilian federal government ruled out the possibility of the United States applying a 'force measure' against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, but acknowledged that diplomatic and political pressures could occur. The concern arose after a U.S. Republican lawmaker shared a montage depicting Lula imprisoned, which was labeled as a symptom of the 'deteriorated political environment' internationally. The Planalto Palace emphasized respect for U.S. sovereignty while rejecting any attempt to intimidate democratically elected leaders.

item.title: Ao evitar debate, Lula tenta transferir alvo para as costas de Flávio
item.description: Lula has not yet rejected Band's invitation to the electoral debate, but in the campaign, no one is advocating for his participation in the first-round debates. The assessment is that by avoiding the debate, he aims to shift the target of criticism onto Flávio Dino, his Justice Minister, as a way to protect his own image and indirectly wear down the opponent.

item.title: Pesquisa: Metade dos eleitores sem religião saturou da polarização política
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows half of religiously unaffiliated voters in Brazil are weary of political polarization, while evangelicals report greater tolerance, stating the divide does not affect their candidate choices in the October elections.

item.title: Excesso de cautela no defeso eleitoral provoca ‘apagão’ e especialistas citam riscos à transparência
item.description: The federal government directed the removal of content from ministries and public agencies during the electoral blackout to avoid accusations of using public resources to benefit Lula’s re-election campaign. This guidance led to excessive caution, causing a 'data blackout' where pages and posts were removed indiscriminately, threatening public transparency. Experts warn that while intended to shield the government, the measure undermines access to information and may constitute preventive censorship.

item.title: ​Alvo da PF, Weverton vê candidatura ao Senado em xeque, e Brandão avalia chapa sem contrariar Lula
item.description: Governor Carlos Brandão is evaluating with his inner circle whether to keep Senator Weverton Rocha on the Senate ticket after the lawmaker was targeted in another Federal Police operation linked to the INSS scandal, raising concerns about electoral contamination for his nephew Orleans Brandão’s gubernatorial bid. Despite the investigative fallout, the group hesitates to drop Weverton due to direct pressure from President Lula, who endorsed him and enjoys over 70% support in Maranhão. With the candidate registration deadline this Saturday, there is insufficient time to conduct polls to inform the decision.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: The Aroeira cartoon depicts Flávio Bolsonaro worried about becoming a target of the right itself, even without Lula present in the studio. It suggests internal tensions within the Bolsonarist base, with risk of political isolation despite traditional support. The image critiques the fragility of ideological unity within the Brazilian right.
